svg.title: Non-Mendelian inheritance: mitochondrial DNA disease passes only through the mother and varies by heteroplasmy and threshold, nuclear mitochondrial disease follows Mendelian patterns, and triple nucleotide repeat disorders (Huntington disease, myotonic dystrophy) are autosomal dominant with anticipation, read by repeat size; each column gives inheritance, presentation, testing and treatment
